effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] If you have a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name, ＜Draw 1＞. If you don't have a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name, you may play 1 Tamer card with [Matt Ishida] in its name from your hand with the play cost reduced by 3.
